articles.title: Lung Adenocarcinoma
articles.summary: Classify adenocarcinoma by its predominant architectural pattern, with comprehensive histological subtyping.

articles.title: Lung Resection Specimen Grossing
articles.section: Tumor Size Measurement; Measuring Invasive Size; Visceral Pleural Invasion
articles.summary: Correlate the section with gross and imaging measurements. In non-mucinous adenocarcinoma, distinguish the invasive component from lepidic growth. Resolve uncertain pleural invasion with an elastic stain.

articles.title: STAS: Spread Through Air Spaces
articles.summary: Look for detached tumor clusters in alveolar spaces beyond the main tumor edge. Check the distribution and exclude displaced cells or knife artifact.

articles.title: Pleural Pathology
articles.summary: Use VVG or Movat to identify the elastic layers when their relationship to tumor is unclear on H&E.

clinicalReference.title: CAP Lung Resection v5.1.0.0, notes B, C and E
clinicalReference.summary: Exclude STAS from tumor size. Pleural invasion depends on the external elastic-layer relationship, not proximity alone.
